content:
Best Buy's big Labour Day sale has kicked off, running alongside Amazon's massive event, and we still have the all-time low on AirTag 2, plus we spotted this 16GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air for $240 off at the Apple Refurbished Store — while stocks last. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features the iPhone Air for $150 off (or up to $359 off on Best Buy's open-box deals), the iPhone 17 Pro series hitting a new all-time low at Amazon with up to $285 off, and a few notable Apple Pencil Pro deals. Grab that new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth while you can — once it's gone, it's gone. Full details below.

Best Buy's 2026 Labour Day mega sale is now live: up to $1,100 off Apple and Android phones, appliances, TVs, and more

Amazon's 2026 Labour Day mega sale is now live! Thousands of deals across Apple, Android, TVs, budget tech, and more — starting from $5

iPhone Air is $150 off this week, but Best Buy's 'excellent' open-box deals go up to $359 off

Best Buy has launched its 2026 Labour Day sale with some of the best deals around on brand-new unlocked iPhone Air units — essentially $150 off across virtually every model. But if you pick one up in 'excellent' open-box condition right now, you can save even more — up to $359 off the latest pricing. Here's the breakdown.

First up, here's the pricing on brand-new condition:

  • iPhone Air 256GB for $850 (originally $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB for $1,050 (originally $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB for $1,250 (originally $1,400)

These are the best brand-new unlocked iPhone Air deals you can find right now at reputable retailers. Worth noting: Amazon doesn't sell brand-new iPhone Air units.

However, as mentioned above, Best Buy is also offering 'excellent' open-box unlocked units at even lower prices. You can browse all open-box stock via the 'more options' link next to each model on this page, but we've pulled out a few highlights — up to $359 off the latest pricing:

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB in Space Black for $807 (originally $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB in Sky Blue for $840 (originally $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB in Space Black for $997 (originally $1,199)

This 16GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air is $240 off at the Apple Refurbished Store (while stocks last)

This deal likely won't last long — the Apple official refurbished store has had trouble keeping M5 MacBook Air models in stock lately (these fly off the shelves). Right now though, you can grab the 13-inch with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $240 off the latest pricing.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store currently has the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,359 with free shipping.

  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare available for purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping not available on refurbished products
  • Limited quantities available

This configuration, originally $1,599, is now $240 off in Silver. It's the only M5 MacBook Air model currently in stock at the Apple Refurbished Store, and we expect this price to sell out fast.

For comparison, this machine is selling for $1,538 brand new on Amazon, and has never dipped below $1,419 since its price increase.

Updating...

Best Buy 'excellent' open-box Apple Pencil Pro drops to $77 — 40% off retail

Beyond the Amazon Labour Day sale offering an Apple Pencil Pro via Amazon Resale for $74 with free shipping, Best Buy's Labour Day event is also live, with 'excellent' condition open-box Apple Pencil Pro units going for just $76.99 with free shipping.

The Amazon Resale option is indeed slightly cheaper, but it's 'like new' used gear — Amazon's finest pre-owned stock, but still second-hand.

Best Buy's 'excellent' open-box units may also be lightly used — essentially returns or floor display models — but Best Buy rates them as 'looks like new' and includes all the accessories.

All told, you'll likely get a very similar condition either way, both being solid ways to pick up an Apple Pencil Pro well below retail (which ranges from $99 to $129):

  • Apple Pencil Pro — Best Buy open-box for $77 (retail new: $129)
  • Apple Pencil Pro — Amazon Resale for $74 (retail new: $129)

The Apple Pencil Pro retails for $129 direct from Apple, typically goes for closer to $99 on the street, and is now down to $97 on Amazon. That said, $99 is essentially the going rate for this product — it's been hovering in that range for nearly a year.

M6 Mac mini pre-order deals now live on Amazon, shipping begins this month

As Best Buy and Amazon's Labour Day sales kick off, shipping dates for the new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro models are also approaching. If you're still weighing up a pre-order, grab that new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth while you're at it, plus the discount Amazon is offering on pre-orders of Apple's new Mac mini.

We've covered these deals in separate posts before, but here's a consolidated roundup for anyone still considering a pre-order ahead of this month's ship dates:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB for $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB for $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB for $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB for $1,669 (originally $1,699)

Among the configurations Amazon carries, the only one without a discount right now is the 24GB M6 model. These aren't earth-shattering discounts, but we're talking brand-new, not-yet-released Apple gear. If you're planning to pre-order without a trade-in, the few bucks you save could go toward gas, coffee, or stocking up on Apple Polishing Cloths while they're still available.

Be sure to check out Amazon and Best Buy's big Labour Day sales this week, plus the latest on Apple's new M6 and M5 Pro lineup:

iPhone 17 Pro series drops to a new all-time low at Amazon with up to $285 off (Renewed Premium)

Beyond the iPhone Air deals over at Best Buy's Labour Day sale, plus Amazon's mega event, we've also spotted some solid discounts on the iPhone 17 Pro. Not every colour and configuration has dipped as low as last week, but we're tracking their highest-quality Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models at new all-time low pricing — up to $285 off. Apple will be rolling out the new iPhone 18 Pro series soon, but that'll definitely cost a lot more.

As I've mentioned before, Amazon Renewed Premium is the best way to pick up a current-generation iPhone — especially the iPhone 17 Pro. The Apple official refurbished store doesn't carry them, and even if they did, they rarely come close to Amazon's pricing here:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Cosmic Orange for $1,214 (retail new: $1,499) — new all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Deep Blue for $1,214 (retail new: $1,499) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Silver for $1,279 (retail new: $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Cosmic Orange for $1,149 (retail new: $1,299) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Deep Blue for $1,165 (retail new: $1,299) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Silver for $1,171 (retail new: $1,299)

All of these come with the full 1-year Amazon Renewed guarantee and 'over 90% of original battery capacity'. Be sure to purchase via the links above and watch out for third-party sellers.

Apple's official MagSafe Battery drops to a new low of $59, or just $39 via Amazon Resale (over 60% off)

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Rare deal: Lexar's rugged 1TB ARMOR 700 SSD hits post-price-hike low at $105 off
  • Labour Day smart home deals on Blink: indoor cameras $19 each (two-pack), video doorbells $48, and more
  • Let a Roborock robot vacuum handle the floors for you — up to 50% off this Labour Day, starting from $140
  • Belkin's compact 45W USB-C charger is an EDC/travel bag essential, now just $15
  • Belkin's brand-new dual-tone aluminium 25W Qi2.2 wireless MagSafe charger sees its first Labour Day discount at $77
  • This universal airplane tray table phone stand with light is just $9.50 (21% off) — great for yourself or as a gift
  • Ongoing: Anker's new SmartTrack Find My wallet card works with iOS or Android, hits Amazon all-time low at $25
  • Whoa! LISEN's Apple Watch charger with 20W adapter drops again, now $9

Amazon Labour Day sale: the cheapest M4 iPad Air is $100 off

Beyond continuing to track the latest all-time low on AirTag 2 and the new M6 Mac mini discounts appearing for the first time during Amazon's Labour Day sale, the cheapest M4 iPad Air is also seeing a price cut — $100 off.

Amazon currently has the 11-inch M4 iPad Air starting from $649 with free shipping. That's $749 retail, so $100 off list price, and the best deal you can find right now.

There have been a few even cheaper blips recently, but those deals vanish fast — quicker than most people can react.

The M4 iPad Air lineup, like other current MacBook and iPad models, saw a price increase not long ago. But with today's deals, we're at least seeing prices come back down a touch — $100 off on the base model. The pricier configurations also see $150 discounts, like the 1TB 13-inch model at $1,399. Still, a $100 cut on the budget model is a solid discount.
